# Health Pool Bug: An Alternative to Set Max Health (PATCHED)

Source: [wiki article 6790](../archive/6790.md); edited 2025-08-25.

<a id="wiki-6790-n1"></a>

- Explicitly documented as patched May 7, 2025, version 2.16.0-138051; the base-health-removal exploit no longer works.

<a id="wiki-6790-n2"></a>

- Historical exploit required current health below maximum and only the target health type remaining; adding/removing temporary pools could remove base pools. Recipes damaging then removing pools or replacing all base health are historical only.

<a id="wiki-6790-n3"></a>

- Normal Add/Remove Health Pool actions are documented not to modify a hero's default pool.

<a id="wiki-6790-n4"></a>

- Motivation remains useful: Set Max Health adjusts overall health scaling, cannot independently choose health types, and may scale health granted by abilities such as Commanding Shout/Fortify.
